assertion_analysis.condition: No reachable failure after a successful module import; this assertion is vacuous.
Fails if the restored strict admission does not lose a root over the bracket.
Fails if the strict-arm bisection does not reach adjacent binary64 offsets.
Fail when the live repaired census loses a root or saddle at either offset; the strict-admission mutation made line 2717 fail in negative-control-test.log.
Fail if a displaced independent polish cannot recover the sampled hyperbolic point with the stated position and flux tolerances, or if it does not persist across the pair.
Fail if the sampler read is invalid, loses a root, or selects an X-point away from a separate polish from the fixed prior.
Fails only when the two sampler current outputs differ beyond the relative tolerance; identical wrong values pass because neither side is an independent oracle.
Fail if the restored arm does not bisect to an adjacent pair or loses no saddle, or if the repaired arm loses a saddle.

0.reason: Split by the coordinator on 2026-10-18 into f-cfs-census-proposal-coverage: the remaining departures are proposal coverage holes (a cell proposes only when its own quadratic stationary point lies inside it), owned by that node; this node repaired the adjacent-pair admission defect.

findings.text: blocking: the repaired census still loses a hyperbolic saddle at 0.173 to 0.1735 on 282 cells and 0.122 to 0.123 on 550 cells, with determinants far from roundoff, so done-when (3) and the broad goal remain unmet.

blocking: booked current is compared only between two outputs of the same sampler, so both can move together to a wrong value while this assertion passes; done-when (5) requires an independently computed current value.
